# Open In

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Opens input in a certain ask.

## Syntax

~~~~text
openIn(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, app: <#String#>, ask: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
openIn(input: Clipboard, app: "com.apple.mobilenotes", ask: false)
~~~~
